newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Puncak Niaga debuts at 4.76 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Puncak Niaga debuts at 4.76 ringgit.

text.p: Water treatment plant operator Puncak Niaga Holdings Bhd listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board at 4.76 ringgit on Tuesday, against a 3.80 ringgit retail offer price.

At 0133 GMT, the stock was trading at 4.60 ringgit. It had offered 67 million new and existing shares to the public, with the retail tranche priced at 3.80 ringgit and the institutional tranche at 4.50 ringgit a piece.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, the company reported turnover of 115.08 million ringgit, and net profit of 45.05 million or 51.80 cents a share.
It has forecast turnover of 121.26 million ringgit and net profit of 41.77 million or 22.52 cents a share for calendar 1997.
The net proceeds to the company from the flotation are 281.23 million ringgit.
Puncak Niaga was listed under Malaysia's Infrastructure Project Company (IPC) flotation guidelines. It is the first IPC in the water supply business to be listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

Asked last month if the company was concerned that its listing would be poorly received following lukewarm receptions of other IPC listings, Puncak Niaga's executive chairman Rozali Ismail said his company should not be compared with the others.

"Unlike the earlier IPC listings, Puncak Niaga has in fact been generating profits in the last two years since it took over the 27 water treatment plants in (the central state of) Selangor and Federal Territory from the state government of Selangor," Rozali said.
